name: Securities Swap Leg
definition: Contains the details of one of the legs of a swap, both in time (spot versus [partial] forward details) and the side (sell versus buy).

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Contains the currency and amount of a buy or sell leg of a swap for the spot or the forward.

Benchmark.name: Benchmark
Benchmark.definition: Contains the benchmark used for a buy or sell leg of a swap for the spot or the forward.

CurvePoint.name: Curve Point
CurvePoint.definition: Identifies a point on a benchmark curve.

BenchmarkYield.name: Benchmark Yield
BenchmarkYield.definition: Contains the yield against a benchmark for a buy or sell leg of a swap for the spot or the forward.

BenchmarkOffset.name: Benchmark Offset
BenchmarkOffset.definition: Contains the offset in basis points against a benchmark for a buy or sell leg of a swap for the spot or the forward.

SpotSellSwap.name: Spot Sell Swap
SpotSellSwap.definition: Swap for which a spot sell leg is specified.

SpotBuySwap.name: Spot Buy Swap
SpotBuySwap.definition: Swap for which a spot buy leg is specified.

ForwardBuyBackSwap.name: Forward Buy Back Swap
ForwardBuyBackSwap.definition: Swap for which a forward buy back leg is specified.

ForwardSellBackSwap.name: Forward Sell Back Swap
ForwardSellBackSwap.definition: Swap for which a forward sell back leg is specified.
